mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting channels to the fibres was most worthwhile because the sequence explained how an electrical change travels without one ion running the whole length.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the blood vessels was clear but less engaging: it mostly confirmed that cells need food and oxygen.

surprise.text: I was surprised that neighbouring channels open in turn and ions only cross locally, rather than one ion travelling along the fibre.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The channel pairing followed a named goal and picture, although I did not understand exactly how it carried a message until the result.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the channel explanation made me curious about how nerve messages work, and bringing the separate parts together was satisfying.
